newsitem.title: USA: New Holland names Lloyd Bentsen as chair.
newsitem.headline: New Holland names Lloyd Bentsen as chair.

text.p: New Holland NV said on Tuesday Lloyd Bentsen, a former U.S. senator who worked in President Bill Clinton's administration, had been appointed chairman of its board of directors.

The Dutch manufacturer of agricultural equipment said in a statement released on Tuesday Bentsen's experience in finance, international trade and public policy would prove to be a valuable asset for the company.
It did not say whom Bentsen would replace in the post.
Bentsen was named Treasury Secretary by Clinton in January 1993 and served in the president's administration until December 1994.
New Holland was formed in May 1991 through the merger of the business of Fiat Geotech SpA and Ford New Holland companies.
